verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Bento serves an llms.txt at docs.bentolabs.ai (HTTP 200, with a structured docs index), and the docs pages are published as Markdown (.md). The docs also provide a paste-in Agent Skills installer for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Windsurf that hands the agent the integration playbook and loads the docs over MCP. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.
